details.effects: Exact hundredth mass accounting and source-entry provenance. Each atomic transfer requires a swept-radius clear visible ground route excluding people, plants, obstacles and unrelated reservations. Invalid references/range cost nothing; performed blocked examination costs0.5. Changed route pauses before charges. Deposits persist as nonfood, nonharvestable matter, never inventory.
